$description: Camellia Design System v0.1 foundation tokens. Canonical platform-neutral data derived from docs/camellia-design-system-v0.1.md. Component tokens are intentionally excluded until the foundation is frozen.

com.cjhuang.camellia.semanticModeConvention: theme/{mode}/... maps to one semantic token name after stripping theme/{mode}.

500.$description: Focus/non-text boundary blue; avoid normal-size white text.

600.$description: Default accessible solid action blue with white text (~4.5:1).

700.$description: Stronger interactive blue for links and hover/pressed states.

tracking.$description: Unitless em ratios; translate to CSS em and Figma percent letter spacing.

frost.$description: Composed material recipes. Generate CSS backdrop-filter and Figma fill/stroke/effect styles from these parts.

layout.$description: Mode-independent semantic spacing aliases; sync to both Figma Semantic modes.

theme.$description: Mode-specific semantic tokens. Translation strips theme/{mode}/ and writes the remaining path as the semantic token name.

expression.$description: Atmospheric background fields. DTCG gradients capture stops; Camellia extensions preserve radial geometry and multi-layer composition because DTCG 2025.10 does not encode gradient geometry/type.
